Hypothetisch ondernemer-voorbeeld (niet: Hypothetical merchant example (not real): Kees runs a bicycle shop and has recently started receiving many payments via a new QR payment link. He notices that his bookkeeper spends hours each week on matching. In Week 1 Kees creates a data map: he notes that the payment reference from the QR link contains only the last 6 digits of the order number. This makes automatic matches error-prone.
Eén concrete wijziging (single_change):: One concrete change (single_change): in Week 2 Kees adds an extra, unique payment reference to the ordering process (for example: orderID-merchantID). This step is a small development task but significantly reduces mismatches in the PoC and is easy to revert if the API later provides different fields.
